intro: The Republic of the Congo is a presidential republic led by Denis Sassou Nguesso.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years after a 2015 constitutional change removed age and term limits. Elections have been criticised.

chapters.title: Peace
text: Fighting in the Pool region ended with a peace deal in 2017.
